Subject: On-call rotation changes starting June 2

Hi all,

Starting June 2, the on-call rotation will switch from weekly shifts to shifts every 3 days. Shorter shifts should mean fresher coverage, less burnout, and more balanced weeks.

There are now 9 engineers in the on-call pool. We're also adding a $150 bonus for each shift you cover, because on-call is extra work on top of your regular job and it should be paid that way.

What's changing:
- Shifts run every 3 days instead of weekly
- Each changeover includes clear handoff notes
- You get $150 for every shift you cover

If you have questions, ask your team lead or post in #on-call.

Thanks,
Engineering Leadership
